title: Darbot Swarm — Mint / Opal Extension
execution_note: These are persona definitions and visual assets, not instantiated or connected agent runtimes.
naming_policy: Mint + a distinct domain role noun. Requested machine IDs are retained verbatim.
material_note: Opal is a patterned material, not a single RGB color. Fallback hex values are used for schema keys and terminals; artwork retains the opal texture.

source_lock.token_alpha_policy: 2048 alpha copied exactly; no path approximation, redraw or morphology. Lower sizes use deterministic Lanczos alpha resampling.
source_lock.outline_policy: Mask recovered exactly from the previously accepted solid64 Nitrous avatar; opaque RGB and alpha recomposed without a new contour.
source_lock.transparent_policy: Outline + original opaque visor/dots + chest token; black negative-space body and external background remain transparent.

palette_model.interpolation: OKLab for the fallback colors; seeded reference-derived material blends at indices 38..54.
